All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the Agency Board, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the Agency Board. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.

NEW BUSINESS

CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR APPRAISAL SERVICES FOR LA PUENTE LANES SITE REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT
It is recommended that the Redevelopment Agency: (1) award the contract to Lea Associates to provide appraisal services for the La Puente Lanes Site Redevelopment Project; (2) authorize the Chairwoman to execute the contract on its behalf; and (3) adopt a resolution authorizing a budget amendment to increase the budget for contract services for appraisals, title reports, environmental services, and consultant services.

minutes_text:
Redevelopment Agency MINUTES
of the
La Puente Redevelopment Agency
Special Meeting
May 09, 2006
A Special Meeting of the Redevelopment Agency of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on 05/09/2006, at 7:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES
PUBLIC HEARINGS
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
CONSENT CALENDAR
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR APPRAISAL SERVICES FOR LA PUENTE LANES SITE REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT
Appraisal Services Rept
Appraisal Contract
Perez moved to award the contract to Lea Associates to provide appraisal services for the La Puente Lanes Site Redevelopment Project; authorize the Chairwoman to execute the contract on its behalf; and adopt a resolution authorizing a budget amendment to increase the budget for contract services for appraisals, title reports, environmental services, and consultant services; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Perez, Chavez, Lujan, Storing, and Solis. NOES: None.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES FOR LA PUENTE LANES SITE REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT
Environmental Services Rept
Environmental Contract
Lujan moved to award the contract to Citadel Environmental Services, Inc. to provide environmental services for the La Puente Lanes Site Redevelopment Project; and authorize the Chairwoman to execute the contract on its behalf; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Perez, Chavez, Lujan, Storing, and Solis. NOES: None.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR TITLE SERVICES FOR LA PUENTE LANES SITE REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT
Title Services Rept
Title Services Contract
Lujan moved to award the contract to Stewart Title of California to provide title services for the La Puente Lanes Site Redevelopment Project; and authorize the Chairwoman to execute the contract on its behalf; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Perez, Chavez, Lujan, Storing, and Solis. NOES: None.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT FOR REDEVELOPMENT CONSULTING SERVICES WITH JWA URBAN CONSULTANTS, INC.
JWA Contract Amend Rept
JWA Contract Amendment
Perez moved to approve the amendment to the agreement with JWA Urban Consultants, Inc. ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Perez, Chavez, and Lujan. NOES: Storing, and Solis.
ADJOURN THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY AND RECONVENE TO CITY COUNCIL
